EUDI_E1_E3_LOCAL.interpretation: Rejects only the narrow counterhypothesis that Linux ETXTBSY makes detached one-image mutation mechanically impossible.

EUDI_E1_E3_HOSTINGER.interpretation: Target-VPS replication supports H-EUDI-03 only as a boot/handoff mechanism. It is not evidence for crash safety, security equivalence, model efficiency, causal equivalence or release promotion.

EUDI_E5_LOCAL_REGION_ISOLATION.interpretation: A writable single inode provides no ordinary POSIX byte-range immutability boundary. The same unprivileged O_RDWR capability needed for state can alter root bytes, whereas split files can allow state writes while denying O_RDWR on immutable root. EUDI therefore requires an additional confinement/integrity mechanism and must prove that it recovers or exceeds this lost OS-level isolation. Hash checking alone is detection, not prevention.

negative_controls_and_caveats: PR 119 also triggered Frank Deep Integrity run 31397800393 with conclusion FAILURE; exact job log was unavailable through the connector at inspection time, so no causal attribution is made to EUDI.
The E1/E3 probe uses a tiny synthetic ELF/state image, not the real Frank model/runtime/database.
The E5 permission result demonstrates an OS isolation deficit, not impossibility of compensation by another sandbox or file-layout mechanism.
